name: Alchemical Potion Storage
body:
School transmutation; Level alchemist 2/legendary alchemist 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components s, M (potion)

EFFECT

Range Target You
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

When you create this extract, you must add a potion to it. When you imbibe this extract, the effects of the potion do not occur.

Instead, it is maintained inside of your body permanently until you spend a standard action to activate its effects.
